## Problem and resulting change

Explain the concrete change and link the relevant issue, if any.

## Scope and claim kind

Identify affected chapters, claim records, assumptions and OMNI IDs. Label observations, assumptions, conditional consequences, values and project decisions. State unknown scope explicitly.

## Evidence and uncertainty

Link supporting sources and counterevidence. Note source dates, causal limits and shared source lineage. Disclose material AI assistance and what you verified.

## Checks and assurance

Report checks actually run and their results, or explain why none apply. Where formal assurance is claimed, identify exact inputs, property, bounds, controls and retained evidence. Explain whether source hashes or prior assurance become stale. A documentation correction does not require inventing a formal proof.

## History and rights

- [ ] Stable IDs, branch history and frozen forecast criteria are preserved, or the intended version/fork is explicit.
- [ ] The contribution is in English and contains no private, confidential or unauthorised third-party material.
- [ ] I have read NOTICE.md and understand that project licensing is not yet selected; substantive contributions may require licensing clarification before merge.

## Open questions

State remaining uncertainty, disagreements or follow-up decisions.
